item.title: San Jose mayor jumps into governor’s race
item.description: San Jose Mayor Matt Mahan on Thursday joined the race for California governor, putting to rest months of will-he-won’t-he speculation about his gubernatorial ambitions. The post San Jose mayor jumps into governor’s race appeared first on Palo Alto Online.

item.title: Midpeninsula sees drop in overbidding, but 2 markets are bucking the trend
item.description: Fewer buyers are paying over asking for single-family homes across much of the Midpeninsula — with a couple of notable exceptions. December sales data released this week by the California Association of Realtors shows that Mountain View and Los Altos stand out, with more buyers paying above list price and fewer sellers dropping their asking prices. The post Midpeninsula sees drop in overbidding, but 2 markets are bucking the trend appeared first on Palo Alto Online.

item.title: Local students participate in national walkout
item.description: Amid a national day of protest against ICE, on Friday, crowds of students in the Midpeninsula took to the streets and sidewalks, walking out of schools and gathering in Redwood City, Palo Alto and Mountain View. The post Local students participate in national walkout appeared first on Palo Alto Online.

item.title: Palo Alto leaders condemn ICE violence, consider local protections
item.description: In response to the latest fatal shooting, Palo Alto leaders are strategizing in case the city were ever to find itself in the same situation as Minneapolis. The post Palo Alto leaders condemn ICE violence, consider local protections appeared first on Palo Alto Online.
